zero_change_interpretation: For both axes, all four horizons, and both learners, physiology never beats the zero-change baseline; every delta_zero_phys mean is negative and all 95% CIs are strictly below zero.
interpretation: No change effect meets the frozen cross-model robustness criterion, but HGB alone shows positive incremental effects over the fitted context model for arousal at 1/11/31 s and valence at 31 s. Because Ridge shows no positive increment anywhere and zero-change remains better than physiology everywhere, this is classified as mixed rather than a robust physiology change signal.
firewall: Exploratory predictive change diagnostic only; no causal, bodily-necessity, or phenomenal inference.
